Definition: to glare, i.e. be dazzling white
BiblicalUsage: tsâchach is used for to glare, i.e. be dazzling white. It appears once, in Lamentations 4:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâchach reminds me that God's Word is exact down to the word, not only in the great themes.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
